categories.name: Commodity-backed Stablecoin
categories.content: A commodity-backed stablecoin is a type of stablecoin designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to a reserve of physical commodities such as gold.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Market-Making Solution

categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Rollup
categories.content: Rollup is a layer 2 solution that aggregates and processes transactions outside of a main blockchain, before submitting them as a single batch, to enhance scalability and reduce fees.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Dex Aggregator
categories.content: A DEX aggregator is designed to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of cryptocurrency trading. It searches across multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXs) to combine their liquidity, helping users avoid slippage on large orders, lower trading fees, and secure the best prices for tokens.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: Quantum-Resistant
categories.content: Quantum-resistant projects are characterised by their use of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (e.g., hash-based, lattice-based) to remain secure against potential attacks from future quantum computers.

categories.name: Zero Knowledge (ZK)
categories.content:
Zero-knowledge proof or Zero-knowledge protocol is a method by which one party (the prover) can prove to another party (the verifier) that a given statement is true while the prover avoids conveying any additional information apart from the fact that the statement is indeed true.

This category tracks cryptocurrency that utilises Zero Knowledge implementation to execute transactions, which may include smart contract execution, value transfer, and others.
